title: atoll scrub --json
description: What a scrub read and found, disk by disk in configuration order (specs.md §16, §25). A disk failed has no line.

applied.description: Whether what it found was recorded: false with --dry-run.

paths.description: In the order they were read.

scrubbed.description: false when it could not be read, or the budget ran out before it.

copies_read.description: The copies read whole that hold what their hashes say.

corrupt.description: The copies whose content no longer matches, read again past the cache, their size and times unchanged.

repaired.description: Of those, the ones another copy, read again first, is healthy for, with integrity.auto_repair: repaired from it with --yes, and to be repaired without it (specs.md §16.1).

quarantined.description: Of those, the ones another copy, read again first, is healthy for, without integrity.auto_repair or when a repair found no room: moved to the trash with --yes, and to be moved without it.

kept.description: Of those, the ones left where they are: no healthy copy elsewhere, or a repair or a move that did not happen.

changed.description: The copies changed since their row, or while read: a modification, for the next pass.

left.description: Copies due were left when the budget ran out; the next scrub resumes at the chunk it reached.
